Arts & Culture LIVE Updated Just now Live updates: Crowds gather for free Turnstile concert near the Washington Monument in DC 
 Banner Staff 10/24/2026 12:00 p.m. EDT , Updated 10/24/2026 2:11 p.m. EDT 1 Share Share this via... Save this story in The Banner app Scan this with your phone’s camera to download Crowds begin to form as fans gather near the Washington Monument in Washington, D.C. ahead of the Turnstile concert on Saturday. ( Jerry Jackson / The Banner ) Grammy Award-winning Baltimore band Turnstile is hosting a free show near the Washington Monument in D.C. on Saturday. Crowds have already made their way inside the gated grounds waiting for the show to start. Follow along with The Banner’s live blog for the latest from fans and the concert.
